item.title: AI Cloning Could Become the Biggest Threat to Video Game Playtests
item.description: Just over a week ago, during the Triple-i Initiative showcase , developer Digital Sun announced the long-awaited public playtest for its upcoming "Tower Defensevania" ReVamp . Now the developer is walking that back, instead offering a much smaller and more controlled playtest through its Discord beginning on Oct. 29. The reason? AI.

item.title: It's the End of An Era for Netflix Movies
item.description: Big creative changes are coming to Netflix. In the wake of massive job cuts at the streamer — some 1,000 employees were laid off last week across various divisions — Netflix is reportedly making sweeping reforms at the top. That includes the apparent firing of Netflix's head of film , who has brought movies like Apex , The Rip , and Remarkably Bright Creatures to the streaming service.

item.title: DC Studios Reveals First Details on New TV Series
item.description: After DC Universe co-head Peter Safran confirmed the two lead actors for the upcoming Mister Miracle adaptation , we now have a first look at the animated show. The promo image shows Mister Miracle staring into the eyes of his longtime love interest, Big Barda, as a silhouette (Darkseid) approaches in the background.

item.title: The 10 Best Steam Next Fest Demos to Play Right Now
item.description: With a busy November right around the corner, Steam Next Fest arrives this week as a delightful appetizer. From now through Oct. 26, PC players can try free demos for tons of upcoming games coming to Steam. It’s a great way to pass some time before the GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time double-header by trying a unique smattering of games that could become your next indie obsession.

item.title: Sounds Like GTA 6 Will Be Full of Details Like Red Dead's Infamous Horse Balls
item.description: Fans have spent years gossiping about a crass detail in Red Dead Redemption 2 that has never been officially acknowledged by developer Rockstar Games. That silence, alongside unclear video footage, made some gamers doubt the detail was truly an intended part of the game. Now, nearly a decade later, Rockstar has confirmed the existence of RDR2 's "horse balls" — and given players a good reason to believe Grand Theft Auto 6 will be full of similar flourishes.

item.title: How to make goo in Enshrouded
item.description: To craft goo in Enshrouded , you must summon the right craftsman and slay a bunch of critters. As it increases your attributes and allows you to spend more time in the Shroud, it's very important to strengthen the flame as soon as possible, but to reach flame level 4, you must obtain the mysterious "goo" substance.

item.title: Resident Evil 7 Dev Reveals the Game’s Last of Us Inspiration and Troubled Development
item.description: It's hard to believe that it has almost been a decade since Capcom reinvented Resident Evil with the seventh mainline game in the series. In the fallout of Resident Evil 6 , it seemed like the once great horror franchise was done for good, but then the developer delivered something of a miracle with the soft reboot that is Resident Evil 7 . That isn't to say the game doesn't have its flaws, something one developer has now revealed in detail was rooted in the tumultuous development cycle it went through.

item.title: Star Trek Actor Breaks Silence on Starfleet Academy's Cancellation
item.description: Star Trek 's immediate future doesn’t look particularly bright. The two remaining Star Trek series, Strange New Worlds and Starfleet Academy , are both ending soon with nothing else in the immediate pipeline. To make matters worse, Star Trek rights holder Paramount just merged with Warner Bros., raising questions about how much attention the series will get under this new megabrand (which now has to pay off $86.8 billion in debt).

item.title: Star Wars Book Officially Solves Luke Skywalker's Most Iconic Mystery
item.description: Every Star Wars fan knows how it felt to watch Luke Skywalker strap into his X-wing and take on the Empire in his first run-in with the Death Star. Fans felt fear, excitement, and then utter euphoria when he pulled off that all-important shot, kickstarting one of the Rebellion's first major victories with a massive bang.

item.title: Pokémon Skateboards Officially Launch, and Scalpers Are Already Buying Them Up
item.description: Oct. 17 marked the release of Santa Cruz skateboard blind bags containing illustrated decks of some of the Pokémon Trading Card Game's best art. Classic cards like the base-set Charizard and more modern cards like the " Moonbreon " from Evolving Skies are randomly packaged in these new products. If that sounds cool to you, here's the bad news: You're probably not going to find any of these in a store.
